subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should the session workspace rail hide workspace-external or fs-safe-rejected transcript paths, or intentionally expose neutral existence metadata for them?
rationale: The remaining false Missing fix can cross from UI state into filesystem metadata exposure, and automation should not choose that boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the bug is fixed by filtering or boundary-preserving display semantics.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The rail may show existence metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, but only with explicit security acceptance and tests.

options.title: Split Layout From File Semantics
options.body: Carry any remaining CSS-only repair separately while deferring external file semantics to a narrower Gateway decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the bug is fixed by filtering or boundary-preserving display semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview hardening makes this the strongest available owner for the fs-safe metadata boundary decision.
